Problem Statement:
Given a number N and an array of N integers, find the smallest number divisible by all the elements of the array. 
Input Description:
Input Size : N <= 100000 
Output Description:
The smallest number divisible by all the elements of the array. 
Sample Input:
5
1 2 3 4 5 
Sample Output:
60
